Limitations: Static metadata/IL validation only; neither the Unity/Mono game nor dedicated server executable was launched.

Public/protected API identity covers assembly identity, exposed type/base/interface/constraint identities, members, access/modifier flags, signatures and parameter defaults. Method bodies and arbitrary custom attributes are not an API compatibility proof.

Direct IL type/member references and declared field/method/local/base/interface types resolving into each original Managed directory are checked. This is not a complete IL verifier or whole-program reachability analysis.

Protected base constructors called directly on ldarg.0 by a derived constructor are accepted. Other protected access from derived callers is surfaced for manual review because the IL receiver constraint is not fully simulated. Friend-assembly or runtime access-check bypasses are not assumed.

Harmony target declarations, known injected parameters and named reflection targets are checked statically. Harmony patch application/order, native Unity calls, readonly reflective writes, object lifetime and network behavior require runtime validation.

Dynamic deserialization types, optional third-party integrations, and generic reflection over arbitrary user data cannot be exhaustively resolved by static inspection. Reflection call-site candidates are retained for review.
